tests.reason: Unicode/control line boundaries incorrectly exposed comment text as declarations and changed opaque inline digests; explicit universal newline splitting fixes both. Third added test covers LF/CRLF/CR provenance, terminal endings and empty input.

line_contract: LF, CRLF or CR separate input lines. Other separators remain characters within a line. Inline digest joins body lines with LF and omits final line ending; not a mkifs-emitted-file hash.
limits: Local Python parser tests, not QNX compiler/target validation, CI or independent review.
No separate old CLI example, external recipe or model rerun. Prior version evidence stays historical.
No browser/HTML preview, registration, final submission or added delivery.
QNX handling of unusual Unicode/control separators has not been tested.
